bio: Co-founded the Prakash Type Foundry in Poona in 1951 with Kalindi Karandikar. It introduced nineteen Devanagari display designs and exported type to Mauritius, Nepal, East Africa and Burma.

sources.title: Typography of Devanagari, Volume One, p. 318 (Bapurao S. Naik)
sources.publisher: Directorate of Languages, Government of Maharashtra
